title: Privacy Policy
intro: At Renty, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, hold, and protect your personal and payment information when you use our website and services. Because Renty holds rent payments on behalf of renters and landlords, we also explain how that money is handled.

content.text: We collect the following types of information:

items: Name, email address, and phone number when you fill our contact or enquiry form
Your rental search details — preferred location, budget, and unit type
Payment details needed to process rent, such as your M-Pesa number or bank reference. Card numbers and PINs are never stored on our servers
Confirmation details after you move in, so we know when to release funds to the landlord
Chatbot conversation history when you interact with our assistant
Browsing behavior and preferences through cookies
Landlord identity and payout information for landlords using the platform
Respond to your enquiries and connect you with landlords
Process rent payments and hold funds in trust until the move-in is confirmed
Calculate and deduct the Renty commission on each completed transaction
Remit the balance to the landlord once the renter confirms the house
Resolve disputes between renters and landlords
Improve our platform and services
Send you updates about new listings and offers (only if you opt in)
Comply with Kenyan tax, anti-money laundering, and financial reporting obligations

content.text: When a renter pays rent through Renty, the money does not go directly to the landlord. Instead it moves through a three-step process:

items: Step 1 — Payment. The renter pays rent through M-Pesa, bank transfer, or another supported method. The full amount is received by Renty.
Step 2 — Commission. Renty deducts its commission from the payment. This is the only amount Renty keeps.
Step 3 — Escrow. The remaining balance is held by Renty on the landlord's behalf. It is not released until the renter has physically moved in and confirmed the unit matches what was listed.

content.text: This protects both sides. The renter is not exposed to a landlord who disappears with the money, and the landlord is protected from renters who pay and then refuse to move in. If the renter never confirms the unit, the funds are returned to the renter minus any costs already incurred.
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us:

items: Remember your preferences and saved searches
Keep you logged in to your account
Analyze how you use our website
Improve site performance

content.text: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect site functionality.
We use the following third-party services:

items: M-Pesa and banking partners — to receive rent payments and remit funds
Cloudinary — for storing and serving unit images
WhatsApp — for direct communication between renters, landlords, and Renty
MongoDB Atlas — for secure data storage
Google Maps — for displaying unit locations

content.text: These services have their own privacy policies and may collect data as described in their respective policies.
We take data and payment security seriously. Your information is:

items: Stored securely in MongoDB with access controls
Protected during transmission using HTTPS
Held on encrypted escrow accounts separate from Renty's operating funds
Only accessible to authorized personnel bound by confidentiality
Never sold to third parties

content.text: We do not store card PINs, M-Pesa PINs, or full card numbers on our servers. Payments are processed through regulated payment partners.
Under the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019, you have the right to:

items: Access your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate data
Request deletion of your data, unless we are required to keep it for tax or legal reasons
Object to processing of your data
Withdraw consent at any time
Lodge a complaint with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

content.text: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at simonmbithi143@gmail.com.

We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy. Payment records are kept for the period required by Kenyan tax law, even after you stop using Renty.

Our platform is not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal information, contact us immediately and we will delete it.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the date at the top of this page. If the changes are significant, we will notify you by email or through a notice on the site.
